sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-MP12 key (RB-MP12) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Federal State Reserve Agency base Service and Repair Center workshop rooms.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: - In the warehouse at the sawmill. The key can be found next to the boxes in the blue locker.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Jacket
- 1x Wooden crate
- One Intelligence folder (on top of the table, left of the wooden crate)
- One 6-STEN-140-M military battery spawn
- Loose loot, ammo
